description: Search the iWonder catalogue of documentaries. Returns matching films with availability (watch free now on iWonder, or which streaming services carry them) and deep links to the film pages. Pass the viewer’s two-letter country code to scope availability to their region.

availability.description: "watch_now" = instantly playable on iWonder; "elsewhere" = on a third-party service; "streamable" (default) = watchable somewhere; "any" = include titles with no watch path

country.description: Viewer's country (ISO alpha-2, e.g. "US") — scopes availability info to their region

query.description: What to search for — topic, title, person, or question

services.description: Restrict to these streaming service ids (e.g. ["netflix","max"])

name: search_documentaries
title: Search documentaries
